\par\smallskip
\noindent\footnotesize Final-state multiplicity \(n\) means \(d\bar d\to Z+(n-1)g\).  \PAC\ rows use Rusticol, batch size 64, output chunk size 128, stage-local evaluator inputs, ten Horner iterations, and \texttt{time-process --target-runtime 10}. The first timing block is one selected LC flow with the helicity sum; the second is the sum over all LC flows for one fixed source helicity.  For \PAC\ rows, generation columns report all-flow artifact generation. The green row is the default \PAC\ route, SymJIT O3.  Generated processes are kept under \texttt{docs/.z\_performance\_outputs}; the driver is \texttt{docs/run\_z\_performance\_table.py}.
\par\smallskip
\noindent\footnotesize To reproduce one \PAC\ row, run generation followed by timing.  This example is the \(n=7\) JIT O3 selected-flow block; for the all-flow block, use the same command but replace the sector/order flags with \texttt{--lc-topology-replay --skip-generic-plan --no-runtime-lc-sector-selector --source-helicities 1=-1,2=-1,4=1,5=1,6=1,7=1,8=1,9=1}.
\begin{lstlisting}[language=bash,basicstyle=\ttfamily\tiny,breaklines=true,breakatwhitespace=true]
env PYTHONPATH=src dependencies/.venv/bin/python -m pyamplicol generate-process 'd d~ > z g g g g g g' docs/.z_performance_outputs/manual/n7/jit_o3 --replace --n_cores 5 --color-accuracy lc --batch-size 64 --symbolica-n-cores 5 --symbolica-output-chunk-size 128 --symbolica-stage-local-parameter-layout --symbolica-iterations 10 --symbolica-max-horner-scheme-variables 1000 --symbolica-max-common-pair-cache-entries 5000000 --symbolica-max-common-pair-distance 1000 --lc-sector-ids 0 --reference-color-order 2,4,5,6,7,8,9,1,3 --symbolica-evaluator-backend jit --symbolica-jit-optimization-level 3
env PYTHONPATH=src dependencies/.venv/bin/python -m pyamplicol time-process --target-runtime 10 --batch-size 64 --json docs/.z_performance_outputs/manual/n7/jit_o3
\end{lstlisting}
\end{landscape}
